title: The Hunger SMP
description: Join the Hunger SMP — a semi-anarchy vanilla+ Minecraft server!
body: Looking for a Minecraft world where chaos rules? The Hunger SMP is the ultimate semi‑anarchy server where you can grief, raid, and conquer, but without the nonsense of hacked clients or toxic cheats. Every player shapes the story — forge alliances, betray friends, claim land, or burn it all down.
